idea-plugin.name: MaskeRade
idea-plugin.description:
Pseudonymize a project before an AI agent works on it, and turn the agent's changes back into the real names afterwards.

  • Terms — a veil list (real term → placeholder) with all spellings derived automatically: FalkenrathLogistik, falkenrath_logistik, FALKENRATH_LOGISTIK, falkenrath-logistik … are replaced in the same form. Stored outside the project.
  • Scanner — finds what is worth veiling: word parts of identifiers that are neither everyday words nor library vocabulary, names after @author, mail addresses, internal hosts, IPs, JDBC URLs, user names in paths, and secrets.
  • Mirror — a pseudonymized copy (contents and paths) with a fresh git baseline. Every file is checked for unveil(veil(x)) == x byte for byte, binary files stay out, and the whole mirror is searched for residues before it is released.
  • Unveil — the agent's changes with real names in IntelliJ's diff, applied file by file or hunk by hunk as one undoable command, or shelved as a patch.
Deterministic and offline — no AI inside the plugin.

action.description: Find names, hosts, mails and secrets worth veiling
Create the pseudonymized mirror of the project
Start a terminal in the mirror to run the agent there
Turn the agent's changes back into real names and apply them
Diff two folders (veiled or not) and save the difference as a patch
Copy only what is needed to understand the project, without renaming
Re-create the mirror from the current original
